argv:
set -euo pipefail
    INSTALL_DIR='/home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/install'
    BIN=$INSTALL_DIR/bin
    export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$INSTALL_DIR/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
    export PATH="$BIN:$PATH"
    export PGOPTIONS="${PGOPTIONS:--c client_min_messages=warning}"

    # 1. Ensure bcdb_gate_diagnostics function exists
    $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p '5448' -U postgres postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bcdb_gate_diagnostics()
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE internal
AS 'bcdb_gate_diagnostics';
" >/dev/null

    # 2. Ensure local benchmark role exists
    $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "
      DO \$\$
      BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'neel') THEN
          CREATE ROLE neel LOGIN SUPERUSER;
        END IF;
      END
      \$\$
    " >/dev/null

    # 3. Set synchronous Merkle GUCs
    $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres       -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET enable_merkle_index = 'on'"
    $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres       -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET merkle_apply_synchronous_direct = 'on'"
    $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres       -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET synchronous_commit = 'on'"
    $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres       -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT pg_reload_conf()" >/dev/null

    # 4. Write PostgreSQL run markers
    mkdir -p '/home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/repo'
    echo 'RUN_MARKER run_id=cluster4_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ_f32s1024_A_r3 cluster_id=cluster4_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ_f32s1024_A_r3 phase=postgres_ready node_id=1 started_at='"$(date -Is)" >> '/home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/repo/server.log'
    echo 'RUN_MARKER run_start_epoch=1790838536' >> '/home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/repo/server.log'

    # 5. Bootstrap Merkle schema/recovery if needed
    if [[ 'off' == 'safe' || '1' -eq 1 ]]; then
      bash '/home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/repo/scripts/distributed/bootstrap_raft_apply_ledger.sh'         --db 'postgres' --port '5448' --user 'postgres' --schema-only --reset-for-restore >/dev/null
    fi

    # 6. Restore table if needed
    if [[ '0' -eq 0 ]]; then
      test -f '/home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/repo/scripts/restore_usertable_small.sql' || { echo 'missing restore SQL: /home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/repo/scripts/restore_usertable_small.sql' >&2; exit 1; }
      $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres         -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1         -v merkle_partitions='200'         -v merkle_fanout='32'         -v merkle_split_threshold='1024'         -v merkle_merge_threshold='256'         -v bench_enable_merkle='1'         -f '/home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/repo/scripts/restore_usertable_small.sql' >/dev/null
      if [[ '1' -eq 0 ]]; then
        $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DO \$\$
          DECLARE r record;
          BEGIN
            FOR r IN
              SELECT c.oid
                FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
                JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = c.oid
                JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON t.oid = i.indrelid
                JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid = c.relam
               WHERE t.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
                 AND t.relname = 'usertable_small'
                 AND am.amname = 'merkle'
            LOOP
              EXECUTE format('DROP INDEX %s', r.oid::regclass);
            END LOOP;
          END
        \$\$;" >/dev/null
      fi
      $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "VACUUM ANALYZE usertable_small;" >/dev/null
      cnt=$($BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -tAc 'SELECT count(*) FROM usertable_small')
      if [[ '1' -eq 1 ]]; then
        root=$($BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -tAc "SELECT merkle_root_hash('usertable_small')")
        verify=$($BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -tAc "SELECT merkle_verify('usertable_small')")
      else
        root=disabled
        verify=disabled
      fi
      echo "count=$cnt root=$root verify=$verify"
    else
      $BIN/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "VACUUM ANALYZE usertable_small;" >/dev/null
      echo "setup complete (restore skipped, table vacuum analyzed)"
    fi
